claims: Andy Enfield is the head men's basketball coach at Southern Methodist University (SMU).
Andy Enfield was hired in April 2024 to lead the Southern Methodist University (SMU) team into the ACC.
Andy Enfield was formerly the head coach at USC for 11 seasons.
Andy Enfield previously coached in the NBA.
Andy Enfield is known for his "Dunk City" Florida Gulf Coast team.
